title: Development of an in-house, one-step RT-qPCR mix and optimized MS2 detection primers for hepatitis A virus and norovirus detection in berries1
author: Low, Böhnlein, et al.

steps.title: Generate external control RNA
steps.instruction: Amplify target sequences with T7 promoter using Q5 High‑Fidelity Polymerase and primers from Supplementary Table 1; purify PCR products with Monarch PCR Purification Kit; transcribe RNA with HiScribe T7 High Yield RNA Synthesis Kit; purify RNA with Monarch RNA Cleanup Kit (500 µg); measure concentration on NanoDrop ND‑1000; dilute to 120 ng/µL (HAV), 63 ng/µL (HuNoV‑GI) and 65 ng/µL (HuNoV‑GII) (≈10¹² copies/µL); aliquot and store at –70 °C in RNA Storage Solution.

steps.title: Obtain primers and probes
steps.instruction: Order real‑time PCR primers and hydrolysis probes as listed in Table 1 (Metabion) and the MS2 process‑control primers (original TM2 and optimized TM2c) according to Annex D of ISO 15216‑2:2019; use final concentrations of 500 nM forward, 900 nM reverse and 250 nM probe for each virus; include specified 5′/3′ modifications (FAM, MGBNFQ, TAMRA, BHQ‑1, Texas Red, BHQ‑2).

steps.title: Prepare in‑house RT‑qPCR mix
steps.instruction: Create enzyme stock by mixing 1 µL SuperScript™ IV RT (200 U/µL) with 200 µL Platinum™ II Taq Hot‑Start DNA Polymerase (5 U/µL). For each 25 µL reaction add: 0.40 µL enzyme stock (0.4 U RT, 0.8 U Taq), 1.14 µL Platinum II Taq PCR buffer (5×), 0.125 µL 100 mM DTT (final 0.5 mM), 1.00 µL 10 mM each dNTP (final 0.4 mM each), 0.40 µL UltraPure™ BSA (50 mg/mL, final 800 µg/mL), 0.4125 µL primers‑probe‑mix (stock: 30.3 µM forward, 54.55 µM reverse, 15.15 µM probe), 0.125 µL RNase Inhibitor Hu (40 U/µL, final 5 U), 5.00 µL template RNA, and nuclease‑free water to 25 µL total.

steps.title: Run RT‑qPCR program
steps.instruction: Load 25 µL reactions onto Bio‑Rad CFX96 Touch. Cycle: 55 °C 1 h (reverse transcription), 95 °C 5 min (enzyme inactivation/hot‑start), then 45 cycles of 95 °C 15 s, 60 °C 1 min (annealing), 65 °C 1 min (extension) with fluorescence acquisition at the end of each extension step.

steps.title: Use commercial RT‑qPCR kits (optional)
steps.instruction: If preferred, perform reactions with the RNA UltraSense One‑Step Quantitative RT‑PCR System (Thermo Fisher) or Luna® Probe One‑Step RT‑qPCR 4X Mix with UDG (NEB) according to the manufacturers’ instructions in 25 µL volumes.

steps.title: Optimize buffer concentration
steps.instruction: Test five concentrations of Platinum II Taq PCR buffer (1×, 1.5×, 2×, 2.5×, etc.) using 1 U SuperScript IV RT and 1 U Platinum II Taq per well; run reactions with high (10⁶) and low (10²) copies of norovirus GI ecRNA; perform two independent experiments with two technical replicates each (total 4 data points).

steps.title: Determine RT‑Taq ratio
steps.instruction: Combine 0.1–1.6 U SuperScript IV RT with 1 U Platinum II Taq per well; test with 10⁶ copies and with lower copy numbers (10³, 10²) of norovirus GI ecRNA; conduct three independent experiments, each with 2–3 technical replicates (total 7 data points).

steps.title: Isolate viral RNA from berries
steps.instruction: For each sample: thaw 25 g raspberries, spike with 10 µL MS2 virus (5.5 × 10⁶ PFU), place in 400 mL filter bag; add TGBE buffer containing 1900 U pectinase (Aspergillus aculeatus, Sigma); incubate on rocking shaker at 60 rpm for 20 min, adjusting pH to 9–10 with 13 M NaOH every 10 min (up to three adjustments, each adding 10 min). Centrifuge filter chamber 30 min at 10 000 × g, 5 °C; collect supernatant and neutralize to pH 7 with 10 M HCl; add 0.25 volume of 5× PEG/NaCl solution, incubate 60 min at 5 °C with rocking 60 rpm; pellet virus by centrifugation 35 min at 10 000 × g, 5 °C; resuspend pellet in 500 µL PBS; vortex with 500 µL chloroform/butanol (50/50), centrifuge 15 min at 10 000 × g, 5 °C; transfer the aqueous top phase (~500 µL) to a NucleoSpin Virus Mini Kit column, using scaled lysis (2 mL RAV1 buffer + 2 mL ethanol); load sample in successive aliquots until all volume passes; wash and elute RNA with 100 µL nuclease‑free water.

steps.title: Perform MS2 recovery assay
steps.instruction: Run two independent experiments, each using three raspberry samples prepared as above; quantify MS2 recovery by RT‑qPCR using the in‑house mix.

steps.title: Multiplex virus detection in strawberries
steps.instruction: Use frozen strawberry samples (25 g) artificially contaminated as follows: Sample 1 – 3.2 × 10⁴ genome copies HuNoV‑GI.4 and 1.1 × 10⁴ copies HAV per 25 g; Sample 2 – 1.6 × 10⁵ genome copies HuNoV‑GII.P16/GII.4 and 1.1 × 10⁴ copies HAV per 25 g. Extract viral RNA as described for berries, then set up RT‑qPCR reactions with the in‑house 2× enzyme mix, adding primer‑probe mixes for each target at the same final concentrations as in the corresponding singleplex assays. Run the RT‑qPCR program and record fluorescence.

steps.title: Analyze qPCR data
steps.instruction: Import raw fluorescence data into Bio‑Rad CFX Maestro 2.3; determine Ct values, calculate recovery percentages, and apply outlier exclusion (Ct deviating >4 cycles from the mean) before statistical analysis.
